The international benchmark Brent crude fell below $90 for the first time since April 14, while its US counterpart, West Texas Intermediate crude fell to around $86 a barrel.

title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
description: Indian equities ended higher on Tuesday, supported by easing geopolitical tensions and softer crude prices. A sharp drop in India VIX boosted sentiment, while broader markets outperformed. Analysts see potential for further recovery, though caution persists amid FII outflows, global uncertainties and weak near-term earnings outlook.

title: PE investor BC Investments sells Rs 612 crore stake in Emcure Pharma; Kotak MF picks up stake
description: Private equity firm BC Investments IV sold a Rs 612 crore stake in Emcure Pharmaceuticals to Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund at Rs 1,700 per share. Despite this divestment, analysts remain positive on Emcure's growth outlook across its core therapeutic segments.

title: Market Trading Guide: CCL Products among 2 stock recommendations for Wednesday
description: Domestic markets are showing signs of recovery after recent declines, aided by easing geopolitical tensions and softer crude prices. However, volatility persists due to FII outflows and global uncertainties. Analysts recommend CCL Products and CMPDI, citing strong technical setups, positive momentum and bullish chart patterns.

title: Pride Hotels signs 141-key property in Indore
description: Pride Hotels Limited is thrilled to announce the addition of a new 141-key hotel in the vibrant city of Indore, Madhya Pradesh. This exciting launch marks the fifth Plaza Hotel under the group's umbrella, reinforcing their dedication to providing top-notch hospitality.

title: Helmet maker Studds shares surges 18% as stricter traffic rules enforced in West Bengal
description: Studds Accessories shares soared 18.3% to a 13-week high after reports of a sharp rise in helmet demand in West Bengal following stricter traffic-rule enforcement. The company reported strong sales growth, expects organised players to gain market share, and is expanding capacity to meet rising demand.

title: US stocks: CrowdStrike shares fall as 'Mythos moment' fails to cheer investors
description: CrowdStrike experienced a stark decline in its share prices on Thursday, largely attributed to its quarterly guidance that failed to impress investors. Nevertheless, the cybersecurity software landscape remains vibrant, fueled by significant strides in AI technology. Observers note that some investors opted to realize gains after the stock's upward momentum.

title: NLC India OFS over-subscribed 5 times, institutional buyers put in Rs 4,158 cr bids
description: The government's offer for sale in NLC India saw strong demand on the first day. Non-retail investors bid for shares worth Rs 4,158 crore. This indicates significant interest in the disinvestment. The offer is open for retail investors today. The government aims to raise funds through this stake sale. This is part of its broader PSU disinvestment strategy.

title: Promoter sells Rs 1,024 crore worth of Ajanta Pharma shares in block deal to Kotak MF and ABSL MF
description: A promoter entity of Ajanta Pharma sold shares worth over Rs 1,024 crore through a block deal, with Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund and Aditya Birla Sun Life Mutual Fund acquiring the stake. The transaction comes amid strong earnings growth, healthy margins and sustained momentum in the company’s pharmaceutical business.

title: NSE to route 10% of CSR spending through Social Stock Exchange after regulatory green light
description: NSE will channel 10% of its annual CSR corpus through the Social Stock Exchange, becoming an early institutional adopter of the platform. The move follows regulatory changes permitting CSR spending via SSE-listed instruments and aims to boost transparency, accountability and funding for social impact projects.
